label: EPRI (1993a), Eastern North America
units: SA, PGA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are original_table_required - the catalogue gives the equation and metadata only, with no numerical coefficients - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: EPRI (1993a), Eastern North America

magnitude.note: Two separate regressions, one on Mw and one on mLg. A coefficient file must say which one it carries; they are not interchangeable.

fallback.when: the largest event(s), per the source

site.note: Site-DEPTH categories. Do not replace them with Vs30 except through an explicitly separate, documented conversion layer.
site.anchor_note: RESOLVED: the appendix gives the depth-to-rock definition of each class, via the ZSS / ZIS / ZDS indicators.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; Douglas: coefficients are published as graphs only. Still RESOLVE.

parameters.equation_shape: ln y = quadratic in magnitude + log-distance term + linear-distance term + site-depth indicators

coefficients.needed: C1-C8 on the published period grid. The appendix gives the exact functional form and the site-class depth definitions but states the coefficient table is NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_DOUGLAS - the original EPRI table is required.

implementation_notes: Test all three site classes and long-distance attenuation.
parameters.equation: ln y(f) = C1 + C2*(M-6) + C3*(M-6)^2 + C4*ln(R) + C5*R + C6*ZSS + C7*ZIS + C8*ZDS

resolution_provenance.magnitude.scale: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): M scale 'Mw, mLg'; Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 4.55: the analysis is run on both scales ('smaller inter-event standard deviations when using mLg than when using Mw')
resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 4.55: 'Use geometric mean'; Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code G
